The Planifya journey

From search to celebration.

Discover providers, record the agreement, book with a clear transaction trail and keep every update close.

Discover

Browse service categories, search and filter by location. Check profiles, package details, images, pricing and conditions before booking.

Discuss

Message the provider in Planifya. For custom work, request a quotation that records the service, scope, price, date, terms and offer expiry.

Book and pay

Choose a listed package or accepted custom offer, review the checkout total and use an active payment method shown for the transaction.

Track and complete

Follow the booking in My Bookings. Share the six-digit completion PIN only after the agreed service is actually complete.

E-tickets

Find the event. Keep the QR.

Verified public events can offer ticket packages through Planifya. Choose your tier and quantity, review the event and sales cutoff, pay, then find the QR credential in My Tickets.

  • Review organizer, location, date, tier and event terms
  • Keep the issued ticket linked to your account
  • Present the QR credential for validation at entry
See the complete e-ticket guide
A safer booking trail

Every important step stays connected.

Use Planifya chat for scope changes, pay through supported checkout and keep the relevant booking, order and transaction references for support.

If payment is charged but a booking is missing

Do not pay again immediately. Let the transaction reconcile. If the booking still does not appear, contact support with the order or transaction reference—never your OTP, PIN or CVV.

If a service booking needs to be cancelled

An eligible paid service booking can be cancelled within five minutes for an automatic full refund. After five minutes, the provider can approve or dispute the request.
